articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla., Feb. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Crown Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CCK) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.35 per share, payable March 31, 2026, to shareholders of record as of March 17, 2026.
articles.title: Crown Holdings, Inc. Announces 35% Dividend Increase

articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla., Feb. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Crown Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CCK) announced today that packaging industry executive Michael P. Doss has been elected to its Board of Directors, effective March 3, 2026. The Board now has ten members.
articles.title: Crown Holdings, Inc. Elects Michael Doss to Its Board of Directors
